Calculate marriage entry rates including cohabitation conversions

Source: R/calculate_marriage_rates.R
calculate_marriage_rates.Rd

Count direct marriages and conversions to marriage over nonmarried person-years: unpartnered and cohabiting time both contribute exposure. Married time contributes none. Each marriage episode counts once per spouse, including a marriage beginning at conversion. Untyped unions are interpreted as marriages. Men describe realized outcomes, not male search-rate inputs.

Usage

calculate_marriage_rates(
  population,
  time_breaks,
  age_breaks,
  by_group = FALSE,
  by_previous_union = FALSE,
  conf.level = NULL,
  pool_dissolved = FALSE
)

Arguments

population

A hammel_population with person and union histories and a known endpoint. Observation cannot extend beyond that endpoint.

time_breaks

Strictly increasing finite calendar boundaries in years.

age_breaks

Strictly increasing nonnegative age boundaries in years. A finite final boundary gains an open-ended band through Inf.

by_group

Logical, default FALSE. With TRUE, require person groups and return separate rows by each individual's group. No pooled row is added.

by_previous_union

Logical, default FALSE. With TRUE, separate exposure and starts by previous union category and include previous_union. Otherwise pool counts and exposure before calculating rates, and omit that column. Supplying dur_breaks automatically enables this option.

conf.level

NULL (default) to omit confidence intervals, or a finite numeric scalar strictly between 0 and 1. Adds conf_low and conf_high from two-sided exact stats::poisson.test() intervals for observed event counts over exposure. Bounds are NA at zero exposure. For fertility, these describe the observed rate, not the unrealized-adjusted rate.

pool_dissolved

Logical, default FALSE. With TRUE, return "none" and "dissolved", pooling separated and widowed events and exposure before calculating rates and confidence intervals. Requires by_previous_union (also enabled by dur_breaks). With FALSE, stratified output uses the detailed "none", "separated", and "widowed" categories.

Value

A tibble with time_start, time_end, sex, age_start, age_end, person_years, marriages, and rate_marriage, plus group and previous_union when requested. Empty cells are retained. Person-years include cohabiting time. With non-NULL conf.level, also includes conf_low and conf_high.

Details

Complete, nonoverlapping histories are required. Cells are half-open; starts on boundaries enter the cell beginning there. Exposure is censored at death and the observation endpoint. Rates are NA when exposure is zero. This age-specific measure does not provide duration strata. With by_previous_union = TRUE, cohabiting exposure and conversion retain the category held immediately before that cohabitation began. Ending categories follow the recorded cohabitation policy, as in calculate_union_rates(). For entry into any partnership over unpartnered exposure, use calculate_union_rates().
